hypothesis: excluding heavy issuers (252-session share growth > 10%) raises long-only net excess
rule: F6: drop names whose share count grew more than 10% over 252 sessions (split-like days ignored)
construction: core.quant.tf_screens.dilution_at(P, t, window=252) -> dilution_flag(dil_lit, threshold=0.10) (split-like days ignored); core.quant.tf_books.run_books(B1..B4 base and filtered books)

evaluation.gate: nine-step gate, core.quant.validate (walk_forward 756/126, embargo = holding period)
tightenings: GOV-1 long-only primary statistic vs the declared benchmark set (sign split EW / capped VW -> REVISE)
GOV-2 family gate if > 1 configuration (SPA consistent p <= 0.05 at 1x, BH q 0.10, persistence >= 60%)
GOV-4 block max(10, PW(d), PW(d^2), 2 x holding) for steps 2 and 5: the worse of it and the 10-session result
GOV-7 break-even pre-gate screen: REJECT if break-even < 2 x 35 bp
GOV-3 attribution block; GOV-9 stress table; GOV-5 minimum track record (reported)
evaluation.step9: expected live = 0.6 x OOS (reported, not gated)
